input_ref: jump-revised | Pharmacy advocate: What do I say before I quote a drug price?

output.reason: U-RX-EDU-001-09 is the legal disclaimer text to say when giving a drug price. It states that the price is an estimate, explains what can change it, and says it is not a guarantee. The other two units cover caller checks (caregiver authorization and unverified callers), not what to say before quoting a price.
